tools.name: hello
tools.description: What WakeTrades is in one sentence, three quick-start steps with their endpoints, the Hyperliquid network, whether copying is on for everyone (on, pause or halt), and links to the docs, OpenAPI, llms.txt, MCP, agent skills and Terms. No session needed.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: The full flow for an AI agent, the rules that apply, and links to the docs and the OpenAPI reference.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Plan prices in USDC for 1, 3 or 6 months, the struck regular prices, and the founder rule: 50% off for as long as you renew before your plan ends (lost if a paid plan lapses), first members only, can close without notice. bestValue = 6m.

tools.name: get_leader
tools.description: Equity, open positions and statistics of a Hyperliquid address you could copy: over 30 days, and over 90 days in stats.d90 (with pnlUsd and pnlPct, perps only).

tools.name: start_sign_in
tools.description: Returns a nonce and the exact message to sign with the wallet (EIP-191 personal_sign). Valid 10 minutes.

tools.name: finish_sign_in
tools.description: Sends the signed message. Returns session_token: valid until your plan or free trial ends (paying extends it, no new sign-in needed), 6 months at most, 7 days before the trial starts. revoke_all_sessions ends it. The first sign-in of a wallet creates its WakeTrades account.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Account, copy state, open positions, Hyperliquid balance and network, and copiesOnHold { held, reasons, coins }: held is true when new copies would not open now. tools.description: Definitions of the four exposure levels (prudent, equilibre, risque, advanced): size of your copies, leaders, exposure cap, drawdown alerts, plans, minPracticalBalanceUsd. With equity (USDC) or a session_token (your Hyperliquid balance): recommendedLevel, the most prudent of prudent, equilibre, risq

Leaders to copy (followed in order: up to 3 at prudent, equilibre and risque, up to 5 at advanced; the others stay saved) and the exposure level. tools.name: backtest_leader
tools.description: What copying one Hyperliquid trader would have done over the last 30 or 90 days, at an exposure level (prudent, equilibre or risque; not advanced) and a starting balance (USDC, default 5,000): returnPct, pnlUsd, maxDrawdownPct (worst drop from a peak, in % of the starting balance), feesUsd, ruined,

tools.name: set_advanced
tools.description: Advanced level only (every plan and the free trial). Every field is optional; missing fields keep their value. size_pct: size of your copies in % of your leaders' size across 3 leaders (100 = risque). max_exposure_x: total exposure cap in x your balance, or null for none. max_open_positions: integer

tools.name: link_webhook
tools.description: HTTPS endpoint (port 443, public host) that receives signed copy alerts; it must answer 2xx to a test event. Returns the signing secret once. Starts the free trial if the trading key is already confirmed.

tools.name: unlink_webhook
tools.description: Removes the webhook. Copying pauses if no alert channel is left; open copies stay managed.

tools.name: prepare_trading_key
tools.description: Creates (or returns) the WakeTrades trading key for this account and returns the approveAgent action and the EIP-712 typedData to sign with the wallet. Hyperliquid refuses keys on an account without a deposit. Before signing, check that typedData's primaryType is HyperliquidTransaction:ApproveAgent;

tools.name: submit_trading_key
tools.description: Relays the signed approveAgent to Hyperliquid. On hyperliquid_refused, reason no_deposit means deposit USDC first; too_many_agents means revoke an API wallet on Hyperliquid.

tools.name: confirm_trading_key
tools.description: accept_terms: true accepts https://waketrades.com/terms on behalf of the wallet owner. Retry after 10 seconds on agent_not_registered_yet. Starts copying and the free trial if a webhook or Telegram is linked.

tools.name: switch_to_unified_account
tools.description: Switches the Hyperliquid account to a Unified Account with the trading key (Hyperliquid agentSetAbstraction): no wallet signature. Required for new copies at prudent, equilibre and risque, and for xyz markets at every level. Call it right after confirm_trading_key. Returns { mode, unified }; an acco

tools.description: Returns the payment action and the EIP-712 typedData to sign for a plan (exact price, WakeTrades receiver): usdSend from your free perps USDC, or sendAsset from your spot USDC when the perps balance is short (unified account). The free trial must have started. Before signing, check typedData (not on

tools.description: Relays the signed payment (usdSend or sendAsset) to Hyperliquid and applies the plan as soon as Hyperliquid accepts it. dry_run: true runs every check (action, plan and amount, receiver, token, signer, age, balance of the signed source) and answers { dryRun, ok, plan, amount, from, source, wouldRela

tools.description: How copies enter. limit (default for new accounts): a post-only order at the leader's price; unfilled after 1 minute, it is cancelled and the copy opens at market unless the price is more than 1% from the leader's entry; if the leader exits first, nothing is copied (limit_missed event). market: at m

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Copied positions with their stop and take profit, and openedAt (ms) for their age.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Recent copy orders, including skipped trades and why.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Recent copy events (the same as webhook alerts).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The monthly report: up to 5 Hyperliquid traders per exposure level (prudent, equilibre, risque; advanced picks from any list), with what a copy at that level would have made and lost over 90 days. Paid plan (access: full): everything, names and addresses included. Free trial (access: preview): rank,

tools.name: pause_copying
tools.description: No new copies; open copies stay managed (stops kept, closed when the leader closes).

tools.name: resume_copying
tools.description: Resumes copying if the trial or plan is valid and an alert channel is linked.

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Closes one copied position at market.

tools.name: close_losing
tools.description: Closes at market every copied position currently in loss; the others keep running. One of the actions offered by a drawdown alert.

tools.name: close_all
tools.description: Closes every copied position at market, then pauses copying. Positions opened outside WakeTrades are not touched.

tools.name: emergency_stop
tools.description: In one call: closes every copied position at market and pauses copying. It does not revoke the trading key (only the wallet can, on Hyperliquid › API); resume_copying restarts copying.

tools.name: revoke_all_sessions
tools.description: Signs out every session of this wallet: browsers, AI agents and links opened from the Telegram bot, this session included. Use it if a session_token may have leaked. Copying and open copies are not affected; sign in again to continue.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_payment, submit_payment · Private data: start_sign_in, finish_sign_in, link_webhook, prepare_trading_key, submit_trading_key, confirm_trading_key, switch_to_unified_account, submit_payment, get_report, emergency_stop, revoke_all_sessions · Public sink: set_copy_settings, link_webhook, unlink_webhook, submit_trading_key, confirm_trading_key, submit_payment, set_order_mode, get_journal · Destructive: backtest_leader.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_payment, submit_payment · Private data: start_sign_in, finish_sign_in, link_webhook, prepare_trading_key, submit_trading_key, confirm_trading_key, switch_to_unified_account, submit_payment, get_report, emergency_stop, revoke_all_sessions · Public sink: set_copy_settings, link_webhook, unlink_webhook, submit_trading_key, confirm_trading_key, submit_payment, set_order_mode, get_journal · Destructive: backtest_leader

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
